description:
The status bar in the Elixir implementation is missing cost/token information that appears in the Node.js version.

**ORIGINAL OBSERVED (Elixir):**
```
R7.1k ↓781 ↑1.6k 1.5%/197k (auto)  (openrouter) minimax/minimax
```

**EXPECTED (Node.js):**
```
↑5.4k ↓599 R8.9k $0.003 1.8%/197k (auto)  minimax/minimax-m2.7
```

**Status of each gap:**

1. ✅ **Token order fixed** — commit `opi-276.1`: tokens now emit in `↑ ↓ R W` order matching upstream.

2. ❌ **Cost display still missing** — `$0.003` never appears. Root cause:
   - `apps/octo_pi_ai_openai/lib/octo_pi/ai/providers/openai/decoder.ex` `apply_usage/2` sets `input`, `output`, `cache_read`, `cache_write`, `total_tokens` but never populates `usage.cost`.
   - `apps/octo_pi_ai/lib/octo_pi/ai/model/cost.ex` and `apps/octo_pi_ai/lib/octo_pi/ai/model.ex` have the per-million pricing struct `%Model.Cost{}` but no `calculate_cost/2` function exists.
   - Upstream equivalent: `tmp/pi-mono/packages/ai/src/models.ts` `calculateCost/2` multiplies token counts by `model.cost.input / 1_000_000`, etc.

   **Fix needed:**
   - Add `calculate_cost(model, usage)` to `OctoPi.AI.Model` (or `OctoPi.AI.Usage`) mirroring upstream
   - Call it at the end of `apply_usage/2` in the decoder (requires passing the model — may need to be threaded from the producer call site)
   - OR compute it lazily in the TUI footer from the model's pricing and the accumulated token counts

3. ✅ `(openrouter)` prefix removed — covered by opi-276.9 (separate ticket)

4. ✅ Model quality/speed indicator — covered by opi-276.2 (separate ticket)

**Verification:**
Compare the footer of both apps in `tmux pi-comparison` after sending a message. Upstream shows `$0.00x`; Elixir shows nothing (cost hidden because it is 0).
title: TUI-2: Missing cost/token display in status bar
